item.title: Bulletin updated at 05:50 HKT 01/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the northeast monsoon moderating slightly, it will be warm over Guangdong during the day today. Under the influence of a dry replenishment of the monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week and early next week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 01/03 (Wednesday)
Wind: Light winds force 2.
Weather: Fine. Warm and dry during the day. Some haze later.
Temp range: 16 - 24 C
R.H. range: 55 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
